value.rationale: The relation between a distinguished root hub and global leaf abundance is a natural model feature. A sharp all-finite-size \(\sqrt{n}\) conditioning threshold, the rare exact neutral square cases, strict regression, and covariance/correlation contrast characterize dependence not available from marginals. It is an exact structural finite-sample classification, not an arbitrary small numerical gain.
